subject: gk
question: Which of the following ministries is the implementing ministry for ‘PM CARES for Children Scheme’?

options.text: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
Ministry of Women and Child Development

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Women and Child Development**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The Ministry of Women and Child Development is responsible for the implementation of the 'PM CARES for Children Scheme'.
 
• The scheme aims to support children who have lost both parents or legal guardians due to the COVID-19 pandemic.
 
• It provides comprehensive care and protection to these children, including education, health, and financial support till they attain 18 y
